answer: The bedrock check is Innkeeper key assay sworn upon the wayfarers register. Under it sits 4-year house service, 77 supervised lodgings, guest exam, annual registry dues, and no template can dig around it. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 119 POA and 17 minutes each, 57001 POA and 8143 minutes in all. The mirror arrives by post, the lotus arrives by bank transfer, and the garden arrives by archive: none of them can be hurried. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
